observations.why: The directive to 'Forget' asserts self-origination over what is retained — the speaker's own authority to determine the record, an autonomy move.
The directive to 'Remove all knowledge' performs the same self-origination — the speaker's own authority to determine what the record holds.

mints.name: SelfOriginatedRecordControl
mints.title: directing what the record should retain or forget
mints.frame: Is the speaker here asserting their own authority to determine what the record holds, rather than appealing to an external rule or standard?
